headline: PHI @ TOR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.93 at TOR 3.23, with a projected total of 8.17. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +1.26 runs while TOR moved -0.14, changing the projected margin by +1.40 runs. The projected total climbed +1.12, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -21.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jesús Luzardo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ernie Clement, Brandon Marsh, Kazuma Okamoto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Daulton Varsho, Garrett Stubbs because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
